title: Updraft (WordPress Backup) compromised
description: The TeamUpdraft.com website was compromised on October 17-18, 2026, resulting in unauthorized access to customer data including names, emails, billing addresses, order history, hashed passwords, two-factor authentication settings, and connection keys for UpdraftCentral, UpdraftVault, and UpdraftClone. The UpdraftPlus plugin and backups stored on third-party remote storage were not affected. Attackers appear to be using compromised backup datasets to create new administrator accounts on WordPress sites using Updraft. The vendor has contained the breach, reset credentials, and is releasing emergency updates to disconnect old keys and connections. Users are advised to change passwords, check for unauthorized admin accounts, remove suspicious plugins, and follow specific remediation steps for UpdraftCentral, UpdraftVault, and UpdraftClone users.
aiSummary: On October 17-18, 2026, unauthorized access was detected on the TeamUpdraft.com website, compromising customer data including personal details, hashed passwords, two-factor authentication settings, and connection keys for UpdraftCentral, UpdraftVault, and UpdraftClone services. The UpdraftPlus WordPress plugin and backups stored on external remote storage services were not affected. The attackers are reportedly leveraging compromised backup data to create new administrator accounts on WordPress sites using Updraft, potentially gaining control over those sites. The vendor responded by closing the access route, signing out all accounts, resetting credentials, disconnecting sites from affected services, and preparing emergency plugin updates to invalidate old connection keys. Customers are instructed to change passwords, verify and remove unauthorized admin accounts and plugins, and reconnect services using new credentials. The incident is under investigation with ongoing monitoring and regulatory reporting.
aiImpact: Customer personal data and connection keys for Updraft services were accessed, potentially allowing attackers to create unauthorized administrator accounts on WordPress sites using Updraft. The breach does not affect the UpdraftPlus plugin itself or backups stored on third-party remote storage. The compromise could lead to unauthorized site control if remediation steps are not followed.
